description.text:
Since its creation by David Reiss in 1971, Reiss has established a design philosophy centred on creating design-led menswear, womenswear and accessories. With an uncompromising commitment to delivering innovative and original products it fuses exceptional design, quality and value.

For AW18, the Reiss woman is encouraged, above all, to embrace elements of the unexpected. Referencing classic features from the past to produce a contemporary vision for now, vintage prints and sumptuous fabrics are blended to translate a distinctly elevated, glamorous aesthetic. Taking both design and styling cues from the elegance of eternal icons like Jane Birkin, the collection is spun through a youthful lens with inspiration from modern muse Jeanne Damas. Adding depth and dimension to wardrobe staples as well as signature pieces, the undercurrent of creative flair throughout leaves plenty of room for individuality and interpretation: a notion that is actively encouraged for the season ahead...

The AW18 menswear collection draws inspiration from the transformative period of late-Eighties and early-Nineties New York, as well as the exhilarating and definitive art of Jean-Michel Basquiat, the collection marries the attitude and aesthetic of a bygone era with a fashion-forward, contemporary vision, captures the very essence of a modern life of style. The symbolic and now-signature style of Richard Gere's Julian Kaye character in the 1980 cult classic "American Gigolo" has steered the sartorial ambitions of tailoring this season, which is less about power dressing and more about a relaxed yet refined wear.

Location: Jubilee Place
